name: Baseline monitor: world-model ensemble disagreement (epistemic uncertainty) vs the fork test as an early-warning alarm
written: 2026-10-24 ~05:00, after the exploratory dev run on paired_record_ocl (results/jenga/deep_dive/disagree_check.json: fork 3x 70.9% of topples warned >= 3 chunks ahead at 12.0% safe alarm rate; ensemble disagreement 38-44% at the matched rate) and BEFORE any disagreement value on the held-out set is computed
held_out_set: policy-alone episodes of the margin test (paired_record_m3, episodes 19500-19799; decisions as results/jenga/deep_dive/m3/margin_rows_*: all decisions of every 4th safe episode, the 10 before each topple), fork-test rows already computed (seed 0, as HJ stage B)

monitors.fork_3x: adopted trigger: h_plan < min(h_hold, log2 4) or o_plan > O_MAX
monitors.disagreement: d_all_plan: mean over 16 perturbed futures at scale 1 of the across-model variance of the HOLD30 latent (model_OIL + 4 ens_v1 models), whole frame (eval/disagree_check.py); threshold = the safe-episode quantile that matches fork_3x's alarm rate

primary: share of topple episodes warned >= 3 chunks ahead (within the 8 chunks before topple start): fork_3x minus disagreement >= 10 pp AND one-sided 95% lower bound (paired bootstrap over topple episodes, 10000 draws) > 0
secondary: the other three disagreement variants (outside-hand, relative to hold), each also with the o barrier; warned within 8
